name: claude-mem
ontology_notes: Negative control. Coding-agent session memory, not a companion. SQLite tables: sdk_sessions, observations (type decision|bugfix|feature|refactor|discovery|change), session_summaries, user_prompts, tool_uses. Optional Chroma. Hooks capture tool I/O, worker LLM-compresses to observations, SessionStart injects prior context. MCP/skill search is progressive disclosure (search, timeline, get_observations, get_tool_uses).

ontology.evidence: docs/architecture/database.md tables and observation types. Session summaries have request, investigated, learned, completed, next_steps. Project-scoped, not user/character/relationship.
ontology.label: measured

write_policy.evidence: PostToolUse hook records observations. Worker SDK extracts structured learnings. UserPromptSubmit stores prompts. private tags strip content before storage (docs/usage/private-tags.md). No companion pin.
write_policy.label: measured

read_policy.evidence: SessionStart context hook injects recent observations. MCP/skill search, timeline, get_observations. File-read gate can intercept Read. Agent can search nothing extra beyond the injected block.
read_policy.label: measured

supersession.evidence: Observations append. Session complete is not DELETE. tool_uses UNIQUE upserts the same tool_use_id. No invalidate of an old fact when a new decision lands.
supersession.label: measured

temporal.evidence: created_at_epoch on all tables. timeline tool. FTS5, not a last-Tuesday parser for companion chat.
temporal.label: measured

identity_split.evidence: Keyed by project and session ids. No user vs character vs relationship. Optional hosted/cloud sync is still coding-session data.
identity_split.label: measured

silence.evidence: private tags keep content out of the DB. That is write-time redaction, not retrieve-time skip of a high-score trauma memory.
silence.label: measured

poisoning.evidence: SECURITY.md exists for the product. Observation narrative is model-written from tool I/O with no trust tags. Injected context can carry hostile tool output if it was stored.
poisoning.label: inferred

forgetting.evidence: Cleanup marks session complete, does not delete. No forget-that API in the database doc. Export/import and hosted deletion are product extras, not a per-fact forget.
forgetting.label: measured

cost_shape.evidence: Every tool use can enqueue an LLM compress. SessionStart injects a configured observation count. Search is FTS5 plus optional Chroma. Smart Explore bench is AST token cost, not memory QA.
cost_shape.label: measured

local.evidence: Apache-2.0. DB at ~/.claude-mem/claude-mem.db. Worker on localhost. Needs an LLM for compression (Claude, Gemini, OpenRouter). Hosted/cloud sync is optional.
local.label: measured

mcp.evidence: plugin/scripts/mcp-server.cjs. docs/usage/search-tools.md and claude-desktop.md. Also mem-search skill as a non-MCP path.
mcp.label: measured

companion_fit_reason: Negative control. Remembers a coding agent's tool trace, not a person. Injects project observations. private tags are for secrets, not companion silence.

published_eval.name: Smart Explore Benchmark (docs.claude-mem.ai/smart-explore-benchmark)
published_eval.claimed_score: about 10-18x fewer tokens vs Explore agent on AST search/unfold
published_eval.what_it_actually_scores: Token cost of code exploration tools, not long-term personal memory or companion identity.

open_unknowns: Default observation count injected at SessionStart (configuration.md not fully fetched).
Hosted server beta deletion semantics vs local DB.
